safeguards: Do not treat counts of artwork candidates as counts of fully covered subject targets.
Do not silently restore any rated 0–2 artwork because its subject or image source is technically correct.
A new painting requires a fresh explicit rating or editorial approval before entering the final review; it is not implicitly eligible.
An older subject-specific refusal does not delete an otherwise viable artwork for other themes.
Luminous Mysteries and other Rosary/Marian devotions need their own application scope crosswalk; the 15 traditional editorial mystery selections do not establish comprehensive Rosary coverage.
